summary: The claim range fold and the operation claim digest backfill name their writer holds: each page is a profile operation and a writer holder of its own (`maintenance.claim_ranges`, `maintenance.operation_claim_digests`), with or without task metrics, instead of `(thread tokio-rt-worker)`

replay.detail: No claim, projection or cache changes; nothing is replayed or rebuilt.

schema.detail: No table, index, view, trigger or storage version changes.

rules.detail: Both jobs read and write exactly as before, page by page. Only the label their work is charged to changes.

compatibility.detail: Mixed-version safe: no wire, client or stored-format change. The profile, the writer-hold row of the request-latency report and OTel writer telemetry show two new bounded labels in place of the thread name.

recovery.detail: Rolling back charges both jobs' writer holds to their thread again.
